attempts.notes: Red Cat/Teal's own press release confirms Doodle Labs (Helix Mesh Rider) radios are integrated into Teal systems, and FCC records show the Mesh Rider radio module is filed by Doodle Labs (SG) Pte Ltd. No public source found identifying the specific RF/radio chipset inside the Doodle Labs module (an industry article claiming Qualcomm chipsets in Mesh Rider radios was blocked and could not be opened), so tier 2 is left empty.
